summary: Tested new crate-based forecast + colour logic for /customer-stock-dashboard end-to-end. Seeded 4 delivered deliveries (QA-CSD2-000N, quantities 200,100,200,200 crates, gaps ~30 days) for 'Drive Folder Test Lead' (parent SKU bottles_per_crate resolved to U=1). Backend pytest (4/4) + frontend Playwright assertions all passed. Cleaned up seed data at end.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 93 renders literal '\u00b7' instead of middle-dot '·'. JSX text nodes do NOT parse JS unicode escapes — the subline currently reads '200 units \u00b7 QA-CSD2-0003'. Fix: replace the escape with the real character '·' (or embed as {'\u00b7'} in a JS expression).

action_items: Fix JSX literal-escape bug in CustomerStockDashboard.jsx line 93: change 'units \u00b7 {tile.last_order_number}' to 'units · {tile.last_order_number}' (embed the actual middle-dot character). Screenshot shows this rendering issue in every tile that has a last order.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerStockDashboard.jsx: `\u00b7` inside JSX text is rendered literally. Use the raw character '·' in JSX text, or move the string into a JS expression string literal.

customer_stock_dashboard.py: _forecast() sets forecast_basis using median gap when med_gap<=20 but description says 'monthly buyers' — the branching is correct but forecast_basis text 'usually orders around the …' has ordinal suffix formatting that will pick 'st' for day 21 (21st ✓) — logic is fine.
Consider indexing distributor_deliveries by (tenant_id, account_id, status) — build() scans by \$in over acct_ids which can be large.

seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture inserts 4 QA-CSD2-* deliveries + items for Drive Folder Test Lead and cleans up on teardown. Frontend test used /tmp/seed_csd_only.py to persist seed during UI run; final cleanup removed them (0 QA-CSD2-* rows remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend forecast returns expected_crates as int when whole, else float; forecast_basis contains 'ordered N of M times' when a mode exists. Tile ordering: priority (low_stock) first A→Z, then rest A→Z. Colour scheme: red = rose-700 rgb(190,18,60), green = emerald-700 rgb(4,120,87), neutral = slate-600 rgb(71,85,105). Xlsx header verified. The only UI issue is a literal '\u00b7' rendering — a tiny 1-line JSX fix.
rca of the issue: In CustomerStockDashboard.jsx JSX text between tags, escape sequences like \u00b7 are NOT parsed — they are literal characters, unlike JS string literals. Reproduction: any tile with a last order shows '<units> units \u00b7 <delivery-number>' verbatim. Mitigation: use the actual '·' character or place it inside a JS expression: {'·'}.
